facts.value: As part of your program in another department, you can complete certain modules in our Department of Economics, known as export modules of the Department of Economics - these also include optional modules. This is only possible based on existing cooperation agreements between the departments.
facts.programme_association: Master in Money, Macro and Finance

facts.value: For the programs of the other departments, an overview is compiled of which export modules you can register in the Department of Economics and how you can include these export modules in your program in your department. Furthermore, you cannot integrate other modules from the Department of Economics into your program in another department, nor can you earn differing credit points (CP) at the Department of Economics.
